question: Can paper examples from the exposed lobes distinguish printed ink from paper identity better than the unconditioned head, and do frozen neural features add information beyond local RGB texture?
distinction: Previous palette experiments fitted two uniform RGB colours from predicted seeds. This diagnostic learns a balanced linear classifier separately on each photo, from geometric exposed-lobe samples, and compares local RGB texture with the same features plus frozen U2NETP decoder features. It does not update any neural weights or use overlap labels to fit classifiers.

features.rgb: Original uint8 RGB resized to 320 by float32 bilinear interpolation, local 7x7 mean and standard deviation with reflected padding; all nine channels downsampled to 160.
features.neural: Concatenate 64 channels from each frozen decoder layer after bilinear resizing to 160, alongside the identical nine RGB texture channels. No image coordinates are features.
features.normalization: Per-feature mean and standard deviation from balanced lobe samples only; standard deviation floor 0.0001. Same normalization and ridge regularization in both arms.

samples.rule: Canonical semicircles at (0.5,0) and (0,0.5), radius 0.42, farther than 0.08 outside the overlap. Equal samples per paper, capped at 1024; deterministic evenly spaced row-major selection. No predicted-body gating, annotation or overlap identity enters sampling.
samples.synthetic: All 96 previous training views from 32 geometries. Use true camera/corners solely as a privileged conditioning diagnostic; this does not test automatic cropping or source generalization.
samples.development: All 32 previously inspected, source-separated development photos. Freeze the latest production replay: 26 quads and six unresolved cases. Keep missing lobes, incorrect crops and all other failures in the denominator; no manual crop repair.

evaluation.synthetic: Use every known material pixel inside the true overlap, independent of predicted body. Report expected hard-label error against fractional targets, joint errors including missed body, and boundary/interior breakdown. Whole-image A/B assignment is for scoring only. Recompute prior-head metrics in the same overlap; do not compare directly to historical full-body averages.
evaluation.development: Inspect every photo, including failures, with the prior head and both exemplar arms. No unavailable exact-artwork metric or template success rate. Display in fixed-quad overlap with the existing body; retain raw body/material parity checks against prior inference.
evaluation.gallerySelection: All 32 development photos, and the union of each method's eight highest-error synthetic cases plus any sample failures. Retain all 96 synthetic metric records and new score fields.
evaluation.numeric: Save float32 low-resolution ridge scores losslessly; bilinearly upsample scores and apply sigmoid at 320, threshold 0.5. No threshold or hyperparameter sweep.

scope: Offline mechanism diagnostic for NN paper conditioning. Synthetic geometry is privileged and examples are training diagnostics; real photos are repeatedly inspected development data. No production integration, end-to-end accuracy, cut legality or unseen-generalization claim. All failures retained. Previous frozen-body defects remain separate limitations.
